title: Brazil at the World Cup
description: The Seleção — five-time winners and the only ever-present nation.

questions.q: How many World Cups have Brazil won?
Which World Cup did Brazil NOT win?
Brazil are the only country to have done what?
questions.explain: Brazil have featured in every World Cup finals tournament.

questions.q: Who captained Brazil to the trophy in 2002, lifting it as a full-back?
questions.explain: Cafu captained the 2002 winners and played in three finals.

questions.q: Brazil hosted the 2014 World Cup but suffered which famous semi-final defeat?
Who won the Golden Boot for Brazil at the 2002 World Cup?
Which Brazilian forward was named best player of the 1994 World Cup?
questions.explain: Romário starred as Brazil won in the USA in 1994.

questions.q: In which two consecutive World Cups did Brazil win back-to-back titles?
Who is Brazil's all-time leading scorer at World Cups?
questions.explain: Ronaldo (R9) scored 15 World Cup goals across 1998, 2002 and 2006, making him Brazil's all-time top scorer at the tournament.

questions.q: Brazil famously wear yellow shirts. What colour did they originally wear before changing after a 1950 shock defeat?
questions.explain: Brazil wore white in the 1950 World Cup final and lost to Uruguay. The public was devastated and the team adopted their iconic yellow kit to symbolise a fresh start.
